description.p: Tortuga is a video player that works with Stremio addons. The addons you install bring the catalogs and the streams, and Tortuga plays them with mpv. Tortuga provides no content of its own.

Home shows Continue Watching and your addons' catalogs, Discover filters by type and genre, and Search covers every addon. A title's streams come grouped by addon: pick one and it plays, with embedded and addon subtitles, chapters, and skipping of intros, recaps and credits. Tortuga remembers the stream you picked and plays the next episode from the same source.
Sign in with Apple, Google or GitHub, and your profiles, addons, library and watch progress sync across your devices, on Tortuga's server or one you run yourself. Also in the app:

ul.li: Downloads, with their subtitles, to watch offline
Watch together in sync, each person through their own addons
A profile for each person in the household, with an optional PIN
Trakt, Simkl, MDBList, MyAnimeList and AniList
Keyboard shortcuts, media keys and MPRIS

description.p: The first release of Tortuga: browse your addons' catalogs, play their streams, download for offline, watch together, and keep your profiles, library and progress in sync across your devices.
